title: Not Grease-Proof
text: Not Grease-Proof. Purchased these to use for a wedding and thankfully, I baked a batch beforehand. They are absolutely not greaseproof and bled through immediately. They also must be used with a cupcake pan as the batter will expand and the cup will fall apart.
